newsitem.title: ECUADOR: More Ecuador Congressmen may be expelled for graft.
newsitem.headline: More Ecuador Congressmen may be expelled for graft.

text.p: Ecuador's Congress said on Sunday it may expel 10 more members for corruption in coming weeks following the sacking of 13 deputies accused of syphoning funds from the national budget.
The deputy head of parliament's anti-graft committee, Gustavo Teran, told reporters t: "According to a report from investigators, there could be 10 more. We're working on it."
Congress expelled 13 members of the lower house this week in a crackdown on corruption, the first time Ecuadoran legislators have taken such action against their colleagues.
The Supreme Court ordered their arrest on Saturday to face charges of "illicit use of public funds."

The expelled legislators include Santiago Bucaram, brother of former president Abdala Bucaram who was deposed earlier this year amid massive protests against his economic austerity policies and eccentric personal style.
